observations: Photo 0 and photo 1 show the same used (tokunbo) inline engine sitting on bare ground, surrounded by several other similar engines, suggesting a dealer's yard rather than a single verified unit.
A small metal ID/serial plate is visible on the engine block in both photos but the text is too small and worn to read.
A manual transmission/gearbox is visible in the foreground of both photos, loose on the ground, not obviously attached to the pictured engine.
No spark plugs, dipstick, or wiring harness connectors are shown engaged or tested; no video or sound of the engine running.
Visible grime, oxidation on some bolts, and an oily sheen on hoses consistent with a used/removed engine, but no major cracks or outright exterior damage seen.
Watermark reads 'UDEMEX LIMITED — POSTED ON JIJI', indicating this is a stock/dealer listing image, not necessarily the exact unit a buyer would receive.

identity.kind: used (tokunbo) Toyota petrol engine, exact model/displacement unreadable

claims.claim: Fits Toyota Tundra, Hilux, Tacoma, Camry, Corolla
claims.evidence: These models use different engine families (V8/V6 trucks vs 4-cylinder sedans); a single engine shown cannot fit all of them, so the blanket claim is inconsistent with normal Toyota engine architecture.
No shot of a running engine, compression test, or clear import/grade sticker; 'first grade' is a seller self-grading term with no visual proof.

risks.risk: Exact engine code/displacement unknown, so correct vehicle fitment and price tier cannot be confirmed
risks.proof: Close, well-lit photo of the stamped engine code/ID plate, legible enough to read digits
risks.if_unproven: priced at the lowest-value generic used 4-cylinder engine tier, not as a truck V6/V8

risks.risk: Engine may not run or may have internal faults (compression, timing, oil consumption) invisible in static photos
risks.proof: Video clip of the engine cold-starting and idling, plus audible check for knocks

risks.risk: Engine may be missing accessories or sensors needed for installation (ECU, wiring harness, sensors)
risks.proof: Photo of the full wiring harness and confirmation of included ancillaries
risks.if_unproven: priced as bare long block only

risks.risk: Mismatch between the pictured unit and the unit actually shipped (yard has many similar engines)
risks.proof: Photo of the specific unit with a buyer-requested marker or tag matching the serial plate
risks.if_unproven: priced with no premium for 'verified specific unit'

proof_requests: Clear close-up of the engine code/ID plate stamped on the block
Video of the engine running (cold start) with audio
Specify which single vehicle model/engine size this particular listed engine is for
Photo showing wiring harness, sensors, and accessories included in the sale
response.reason: The engine's code/model plate is illegible and the seller's claim of fitting five very different Toyota models for one pictured engine is inconsistent, so even a worst-case price cannot be set without a legible ID plate or a running-condition clip.
